name: Awesome Claude Skills
summary: Curated list of 1000+ Claude Skills, plugins and resources for Claude and other coding agents, grouped by task area.
description: A curated directory of 1000+ Claude Skills, plugins and resources for Claude.ai, Claude Code and other coding agents (Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity). Skills are grouped by task area — document processing, development and code tools, data and analysis, business and marketing, communication, creative and media, productivity, collaboration, security — and each links to its own repository. Also explains the SKILL.md format and progressive loading, and shows how to connect agents to 1000+ apps via Composio's MCP gateway.
